body: Chief: refinement APPROVED — detection identity = algorithm/version id + Keyed(canonical detector configuration) + Keyed(source canonical text) + ordered detected spans, with only the HMAC render of the table retained. Two requirements: (1) the configuration rendering is a versioned canonical encoding specified in ADR 0001 D6 (field order, escaping, case flag), the same way the receipt rendering must be — a rendering change is a version bump, never silent; (2) the laws you list plus one: two tables that differ only in a case flag yield different config digests under the same key. Proceed after P0-2 lands.
